title: Current GST rates
archive_note: Extract of the prevailing-rate passage. IRAS sets and administers the rate; no intermediary is needed for it.
establishes: The prevailing GST rate is 9%, in force since 1 January 2024
does_not_establish: Whether the Water Conservation Tax sits inside the GST base. That is evidenced by SP's sample bill, which charges GST on each item of the water group.
